correctness.rationale: The exact occupancy weights are a bounded falling-factorial tilt; dominated convergence of the scaled tilt loss and its mean gives the centered first-order signed probability profile in l1. Total variation is half the l1 norm, so the strictly positive constant gives its exact rate. Conditional uniformity and dominated moments give both same-shore coefficients and the cross-shore variance coefficient. Successive-deficit ratios prove the saturation scale, and alternating paths corroborate the finite signs.
